snapshot.name: SPLICE modality vocabulary
snapshot.origin: SPLICE sprint archive SPLICE.zip: splice-lib/src/splice_lib/repositories/seed_data (files dated 14 October 2026)

entities.label: 10x Chromium 3-prime GEX
entities.description: 10x Genomics Chromium single-cell gene expression assay that captures and sequences transcript ends near the 3' poly(A) tail.

entities.label: 10x Chromium 5-prime GEX
entities.description: 10x Genomics Chromium single-cell gene expression assay that captures transcript information from the 5' end of RNA molecules.

entities.label: Xenium RNA
entities.description: 10x Genomics Xenium assay for imaging-based, spatially resolved detection and quantification of targeted RNA transcripts in tissue.

entities.label: Behaviour
entities.description: Data describing observable behavioural traits or activities, typically captured through structured observation, sensors, or automated monitoring.

entities.label: CosMx RNA
entities.description: NanoString CosMx Spatial Molecular Imager assay for highly multiplexed, imaging-based spatial detection of RNA at cellular and subcellular resolution.

entities.label: ATAC-seq
entities.description: Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing, used to identify open and accessible regions of chromatin.

entities.label: Bulk RNA-seq
entities.description: RNA sequencing performed on a mixed population of cells, producing an aggregate transcriptomic profile for the sample.

entities.label: Cage monitoring
entities.description: Continuous or repeated measurement of animal activity and behaviour within the home-cage environment.

entities.label: Chromatin accessibility
entities.description: Measurements of how accessible genomic regions are to regulatory proteins, providing information about chromatin state and gene regulation.

entities.label: Data modality
entities.description: Root of the primary SPLICE navigation hierarchy for biological, molecular, phenotypic and physiological data modalities.

entities.label: DNA methylation
entities.description: Measurements of methyl groups attached to DNA, commonly used to study epigenetic regulation and cell-state-associated genomic patterns.

entities.label: Epigenomics
entities.description: Data describing regulatory features of the genome that do not alter the DNA sequence, including chromatin accessibility and DNA methylation.

entities.label: H&E WSI
entities.description: Whole-slide imaging of tissue stained with haematoxylin and eosin, providing contrast between nuclei and surrounding tissue structures.

entities.label: Histopathology imaging
entities.description: Imaging of stained tissue sections used to assess tissue morphology, architecture, and pathological features.

entities.label: Imaging
entities.description: Data generated by visual imaging technologies that capture tissue, cellular, molecular, or anatomical structure and spatial organisation.

entities.label: Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics
entities.description: Spatial transcriptomics methods that directly image RNA molecules or transcript-derived signals within intact cells or tissue.

entities.label: Microbiome
entities.description: Data describing microbial communities, their composition, genetic content, and functional potential within a biological or environmental sample.

entities.label: poly(A) RNA-seq
entities.description: RNA sequencing in which polyadenylated RNA is enriched, primarily capturing mature messenger RNA transcripts.

entities.label: RRBS
entities.description: Reduced-representation bisulfite sequencing enriches CpG-rich genomic regions to profile DNA methylation at lower sequencing cost than whole-genome approaches.

entities.label: Short-read RNA-seq
entities.description: RNA sequencing using short sequencing reads to quantify transcripts and characterise gene expression in a sample.

entities.label: Shotgun metagenomics
entities.description: Untargeted sequencing of total microbial DNA in a sample to characterise community composition, genes, and functional potential.

entities.label: scRNA-seq
entities.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing measures transcript abundance independently across individual cells to characterise cellular composition and state.

entities.label: SMART-seq
entities.description: Full-length single-cell RNA sequencing approach based on template switching during reverse transcription to generate transcriptome-wide cDNA.

entities.label: Spatial molecular imaging
entities.description: Imaging approaches that measure molecular features while preserving their spatial location within cells or tissue.

entities.label: Spatial transcriptomics
entities.description: Transcriptomic measurements in which RNA abundance is associated with spatial coordinates within a tissue or other biological structure.

entities.label: Total RNA-seq
entities.description: RNA sequencing designed to profile a broad range of RNA species rather than selectively enriching polyadenylated transcripts.

entities.label: Transcriptomics
entities.description: Data describing RNA abundance, composition, and expression patterns across bulk tissue, single cells, or spatially resolved samples.

entities.label: Video cage monitoring
entities.description: Home-cage behavioural monitoring using video to quantify movement, activity, interactions, or other observable behaviours.

entities.label: WGBS
entities.description: Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing measures DNA methylation at near single-base resolution across most of the genome.

entities.label: WSI
entities.description: Whole-slide imaging digitises an entire microscope slide at high resolution to produce a navigable digital pathology image.

entities.label: Droplet-based scRNA-seq
entities.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing in which individual cells are partitioned into droplets with barcoded reagents for high-throughput transcript profiling.

entities.label: Full-length / plate-based scRNA-seq
entities.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing methods that isolate cells individually, commonly in plates, and capture substantially more of each transcript sequence.

entities.label: Targeted BS-seq
entities.description: Targeted bisulfite sequencing measures DNA methylation within selected genomic regions of interest.

entities.label: Short-read shotgun metagenomics
entities.description: Untargeted shotgun metagenomic sequencing using short sequencing reads to characterise microbial community composition, genes, and functional potential.
